messages.content:
You are an expert synthetic chemist planning experiments to maximise reaction yield.
Each experiment chooses one option for every variable listed. You will see the results
of experiments already run. Choose the next batch to find the highest-yield conditions
in as few experiments as possible. Use chemical knowledge (ligand and base effects,
substrate reactivity, solvent effects) and the observed results. Balance exploiting
good regions with testing informative new combinations. Never repeat an experiment.
Return JSON only.

Pd-catalysed Buchwald-Hartwig amination of 1-ethyl-4-iodobenzene with 4-methylaniline; choose the ligand, base and isoxazole additive.

picks.reason: This tests whether the strong performance of the 3-methyl/5-carboxylate additive A13 transfers to the regioisomeric 5-methyl/3-carboxylate scaffold.
This probes the 5-methylisoxazole-4-carboxylate isomer while retaining the ligand and base combination that has performed best.
This tests the effect of a 3-carboxylate without the methyl group, clarifying which features of A13 drive its high yield.
This checks whether adding a 5-methyl substituent to the promising 3-methylisoxazole scaffold improves on A15.
This compares the 5-methyl isomer with the well-performing 3-methyl additive A15 to assess methyl-position effects.
